consumer: mission::is_complete for MGOAL_FIND_ITEM, asking 'does the player have the required count of the contract item' to mark the salvage mission complete
scope: items reachable for crafting (carried plus nearby reachable), i.e. the crafting_inventory() reach -- not on-person-only and not a single map tile
decisive_source: src/mission.cpp::mission::is_complete (MGOAL_FIND_ITEM) -- its body calls u.crafting_inventory().has_amount(item_id, item_count) and returns a yes/no completeness verdict
divergence: All the required scrap sits on an adjacent reachable tile but none is carried: a raw-tile item dump (Excerpt 2) or an on-person-only possession check would report a different yes/no than the mission predicate's crafting_inventory() verdict
